title: Queeniesaidso - MANMADE
htmlContent:
Queeniesaidso music has lately taken the world by storm, and she has yet again unclosed another fire single titled “MANMADE.” This track sends a message that she can spit straight hit into the mic and that her bars are no joke. 

Queeniesaidso undeniably affirms her talent on “MANMADE” with her flawless flow and distinctive voice. She brings separate energy and perfectly complements her fast-paced and unwavering spirit.

Her lyric scheme leaves us all astonished at her brilliance when piecing her expressions together, this is an impressive release from Queeniesaidso, and with this grade of distinction, we must see this continue in her forthcoming releases.

Queeniesaidso's “MANMADE” is available on all streaming platforms!
